title: Rest Awhile - Vacation Rental in Rosemary Beach,FL | 30a Escapes
meta_description: 30A ESCAPES presents… “Rest Awhile,” your perfect family retreat in Rosemary Beach. This updated 3 Suite home offers a private courtyard with outdoor seating, steps from tennis courts, close proximity to 4 community pools, and a quick 2-minute bike ride to beach
description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… “Rest Awhile,” your perfect family retreat in Rosemary Beach. This updated 3 Suite home offers a private courtyard with outdoor seating, steps from tennis courts, close proximity to 4 community pools, and a quick 2-minute bike ride to beach access with 4 bikes provided. Explore Rosemary’s shops, restaurants, and picturesque greens just an 8-minute walk away. Make memories and unwind in this ideal vacation spot. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Private courtyard with outdoor seating, grill, dining space, and an outdoor shower4 community pools nearby, including heated and family-friendly options2-minute bike ride or 6-minute walk to pristine Rosemary BeachMultiple balconies offering private seating and tennis court views4 bikes provided for exploring the charming 30A areaSpacious living areas with Smart TVs, perfect for family movie nightsLocated near Rosemary Town Center with boutique shops and restaurants*** LIVING AREA ***Step into the heart of comfort and elegance as you enter “Rest Awhile.” The inviting family room boasts cozy seating, a large Smart TV, and plenty of natural light, perfect for relaxing after a day of fun. Tailored to bring the family together, this space provides everything you need for quality downtime.Comfortable living area with a large Smart TVOversized windows bringing in natural sunlightKid-friendly outdoor space with additional Smart TV*** KITCHEN & DINING ***Cook up delicious meals in the fully equipped kitchen, featuring modern appliances and plenty of counter space. The nearby dining area is perfect for casual brunches or family dinners, creating memories that last a lifetime.Fully stocked kitchen with modern appliancesDining table that seats six comfortably + 2 seats at the kitchen barConvenient access to outdoor dining in the courtyard*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***The private courtyard is the star of the show! With ample seating, a barbecue grill, and an outdoor shower, it’s a haven for outdoor fun. Start your mornings with coffee on the balcony and end your evenings by dining al fresco under the stars.Private courtyard with dining space, seating area, and grillOutdoor shower for quick post-beach rinsesTwo balconies for relaxing and taking in the Gulf breeze*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Spread across two floors, Rest Awhile offers peaceful sleeping quarters for everyone in the family. Each room features plush bedding and an inviting ambiance to ensure a restful stay.1st Floor:Queen Guest Suite with direct access to the shared full bathroom2nd Floor:Primary Suite with a luxurious King Bed, private balcony, and spacious en-suite bathroom featuring a soaking tub and double vanityQueen Guest Suite with two Queen Beds and a private en-suite bathroom*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Located in the heart of Rosemary Beach, “Rest Awhile” grants you unparalleled access to this enchanting coastal community. From award-winning architecture to picturesque greens and shops, you’ll be surrounded by everything you need for a memorable getaway. Plus, it's just seconds from tennis courts and steps from 4 community pools, making it the perfect spot for relaxation and recreation.Rosemary Beach Community: Beachside destination with award-winning architectureRacquet Club – one of the world’s top 75 tennis spotsMultiple parks & greens with playgrounds, a splash pad, butterfly park, and hidden boardwalks with fountainsFitness Center with massage and yoga4 RESORT POOLSBarbados Pool: Gulf-side, French West Indies style with a fountainCoquina Pool: Gulf-side, with a relaxing negative edge overflowSky Pool: Park-side, indoor, heated year-round with radiant heated decking in winterCabana Pool: Park-side, cabana-style with a children’s pool & playground nearby*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased during checkout or independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentWaiver required to get access to the 4 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 59302STRO #: STR-059302
